title: Sources: PayPal, Epic, and others voiced concerns to DOJ as it signaled a preference to settle its Apple antitrust suit with a deal focusing on interoperability (Aaron Tilley/The Information)
summary: Aaron Tilley / The Information: Sources: PayPal, Epic, and others voiced concerns to DOJ as it signaled a preference to settle its Apple antitrust suit with a deal focusing on interoperability — As the U.S. Department of Justice negotiates a settlement of its antitrust lawsuit against Apple, app developers are fretting …
